strings.text: The mist hasn't yet made up its mind whether to leave.
strings.translation: Туман ещё не решил, уходить ли.

strings.text: The fisherman has been sitting here since four. Not a single bite yet.
strings.translation: Рыбак сидит здесь с четырёх. Пока ни одной.

strings.text: He says he doesn't come for the fish.
